pattern: Loop with no code after end
symptom: After death or bust, the thread renames itself and runs into other code
check: Fall-through scan; thread name changes in scrlog.log
fix: Add terminate_this_script, or wait and goto the loop label

pattern: return with an empty gosub stack
symptom: Instruction pointer above 1000000; invalid opcodes or NOP runs; access violation
check: scrlog.log shows RETURN then a wild address
fix: Never run into a subroutine; reach it by gosub

pattern: Mission body with no gosub wrapper
symptom: A death mid-mission reads past the stack
check: Mission script whose first statement is not a call
fix: Call the body as a function, then test has_deatharrest_been_executed

check: The opcode sits in MAIN or a started script
fix: Remove it, or move it into the mission script

symptom: A gate that tests $ONMISSION == 0 never opens
check: scrlog.log shows the flag test FALSE
fix: Set $ONMISSION = 0 when the mission or tutorial ends

pattern: Script block with no terminate at the end
symptom: The thread runs off the end of the script
check: Last label of the file; prototypes

symptom: Tests run on the old build
fix: Fail the build when the output file is not newer

check: Edit marker lines absent after a compile

pattern: Pickup not recreated after mission retry
symptom: Tutorial loops on a pickup prompt that cannot be completed
check: Retry follows death/arrest after pickup collection and does not recreate the handle
fix: Remove the stale pickup handle and create a fresh pickup in the retry handler

pattern: Tutorial waits on a weapon pickup
symptom: The prompt repeats and HasBeenCollected never turns true when the player already holds a weapon in that slot
check: The player took a melee weapon (all melee share slot 2) before the mission
fix: Remove the pickup, call GiveWeapon, then SetCurrentWeapon so the weapon is equipped without a Tab press

pattern: Long wait while a countdown timer shows
symptom: The timer keeps running after the event it counts toward
check: A wait of 20000 or more sits between DisplayTimer and the check
fix: Poll with a short wait and test the event and $TIMER == 0 each pass; call ClearTimer on every exit
